notes: Four independently movable parts are visibly manipulated. “On” denotes open and “off” denotes closed. The two upper-cabinet leaves close in rapid succession around frames 592–608, so their individual closure order and midpoints are approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen and manipulates the refrigerator door, the two separate hinged leaves of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, and the top drawer beside the oven.
